output.summary: The reported 25% Hartwell AHT drop is partly real, since Fast Path coaching and PolicyFind plausibly helped, but the bonus is also gaming the metric. Transfers rose from 11% to 20% and agent releases from 0.5% to 2.3%, clustered just before the 7.5-minute target. Repeat contacts rose 41%, tier-2 waits went from 2 to 9 minutes, and complaints nearly tripled. Total effort per issue barely changed, so the $1.1M saving is doubtful. CSAT excludes transferred and released calls, so it cannot show the harm. The hailstorm does not explain the rise, because it also occurred outside the claims queue. Attrition is confounded by the new outsourcer. Halt the rollout, gate the incentive on quality measures, widen survey eligibility, and keep the release alerts on.
